feature_unavailable: Team projects are not enabled for this account.
project_context_mismatch: The project on this page does not match the project in the request. Reload the page.
project_not_found: This project was not found, or you are no longer a member.
project_member_not_found: This person is not a member of the project. Refresh the member list.
invite_not_found: This invitation link is not valid. Ask for a new invitation.
budget_request_not_found: This budget request no longer exists. Refresh the list.
undo_expired: The 10 minutes to undo have passed. Invite the person again.
invalid_budget: The budget must be zero or more, or left empty for no limit. Check the amount and save again.
invalid_effort_cap: This reasoning effort cap is not an available level. Choose one from the list.
invalid_settings: A project setting has an invalid value. Check the settings and save again.
cannot_edit_own_budget: You can't change your own budget. Ask another admin to change it.
cannot_change_owner: The owner's role and status can't be changed.
confirm_mismatch: The project name doesn't match. Type the name exactly as shown.
resend_too_soon: This invitation was just sent. Wait a minute before resending.
request_pending: A budget request is already pending. Wait for it to be handled, or withdraw it first.
invalid_pagination: This page of the list can't be shown. Refresh the page.
already_member: This person is already a member.
already_invited: This address already has a pending invitation. Resend that invitation instead.
invite_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
invite_revoked: This invitation was revoked. Ask for a new one if you still need access.
invite_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with that address to accept it.
invite_email_unverified: Verify your email address before accepting this invitation.
invitee_feature_unavailable: That account cannot join a project yet. Try a different email, or check again later.
invite_email_invalid: This email address is not valid. Check it and try again.
invite_role_invalid: Choose admin or member as the role.
project_name_invalid: The project name can't be empty or longer than 191 characters.
project_deletion_dependency: This account still owns or belongs to a team project whose members, payments or Keys depend on it. Resolve those projects before deleting the account.
